system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: Self

You have learned to channel your own pain and loneliness into feeding the malefic energy suffusing your body, transforming you into a ruthlessly efficient killing machine.

Until the start of your next turn, while you have no allies within a 5-space-radius of you, or you have suffered at least 1 Wound, or you have less than half your Stamina remaining, your Melee, Accuracy, and Armor increase by +2.

If these conditions are no longer met, these effects fade until they are met again.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.EELlEHerpmkGODhy]{Stormcaller's Requiem}
